d:
Some discoveries are so strange, they leave even seasoned investigators searching for answers. In Expedition X, Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot investigate mysterious creatures, unexplained sightings and extraordinary phenomena that challenge what we think we know.
From bizarre encounters and unusual evidence to discoveries hidden in the most unexpected places, every investigation takes them further into the unknown. But how much of the unexplained can really be explained?
Watch Expedition X, Season 3, Episodes 1, 7, 11, 4, 8, 2, 10, 9 & 5 on Discovery Channel India.
